Good morning, Rafael. So, are you ready to talk about the three-year contract?
Yes. To begin with, thank you for your trust. We have worked together since 2025, and we want to continue.
Great. Our target for 2027 is six hundred tons of mangoes. Is that possible?
Yes. We are going to plant two new farms, so we can deliver more.
Good. And the timeline? We need the first shipment by March.

Hi team, it's Claire. A quick update about Picunha. I talked to Rafael this morning, and the three-year contract is almost ready. As you know, we have worked with Picunha since 2025, and they have never missed a delivery. Next year we are going to buy six hundred tons of mangoes from them, and the first shipment will arrive by March. Their new farms are on track. However, the rainy season is always a risk, so we should keep some fruit from Mexico too. Rafael is going to send the draft contract by Friday. Please read it by next Wednesday and send me your feedback. To sum up: a reliable partner, a clear plan, and a long contract. Thanks, everyone.

Hello Rafael, it's Marcos from the farms. Good news about the new farms. The work is on track. We have finished two of the three irrigation systems, and the last one will be ready by the end of November. Although it rained a lot last week, we didn't lose any time. As a result, we are going to have the first mangoes in February, before the Harbor Fresh deadline. One more thing: we need two more workers until the harvest. Can we talk about it on Monday? Thanks.

First, thank Claire for her trust. Then, remember how long you have worked together. Next, explain the plan: two new farms for the new target. After that, talk about the first deadline and the risk. Finally, give the key takeaway and send the draft by Friday.
